sloka: पूर्वम् एव मया सृष्टो जांबवान् ऋक्ष पुङ्गवः ।जृंभमाणस्य सहसा मम वक्रात् अजायत ॥१-१७-७॥
transliteration: pūrvam eva mayā sṛṣṭo jāṁbavān ṛkṣa puṅgavaḥ ।jṛṁbhamāṇasya sahasā mama vakrāt ajāyata ॥1-17-7॥

translations.english: Instructed by Brahma in that manner, all of them gave birth to sons in the form of monkeys.
